This is just a reference note, not a build script. It doesn't need to be knitted to be useful, open it in RStudio and read it as plain text whenever you forget where something lives in the site.

## Add a new publication

Create a new file in `_publications/`, named `YYYY-MM-DD-short-title.md`. Copy an existing one and edit the front matter:

```
---
title: "Paper title"
collection: publications
category: manuscripts
permalink: /publication/short-title
excerpt: 'One or two sentence summary'
date: 2026-08-01
venue: 'Journal Name'
paperurl: 'https://doi.org/xx.xxxx/xxxxx'
citation: 'Khanal, S. et al. (2026). Title. Journal Name.'
---
```
`category` must be one of `books`, `manuscripts`, or `conferences` (defined in `_config.yml` under `publication_category`).

## Hide a publication (without deleting it)

Move the file from `_publications/` into `_drafts/` (create that folder if needed), or add `published: false` to its front matter. Either way it stops appearing on the site but the file stays in the repo for later.

## Add a new blog post / announcement

Create a file in `_posts/`, named `YYYY-MM-DD-short-title.md`:

```
---
title: "Your headline"
date: 2026-08-01
categories: publications   # or: talks, activities, general
tags: [optional, keywords]
---

Write it however you'd write a LinkedIn post.
```

Shows up automatically at `/year-archive/` (linked as "Updates" in the nav), newest first.

## Add a talk / presentation

New file in `_talks/`, same date-prefixed naming:

```
---
title: "Talk title"
collection: talks
type: "Conference presentation"
permalink: /talks/short-title
venue: "Conference name"
date: 2026-08-01
location: "City, Country"
---
Short description.
```

## Add an award

Add one entry to `_data/awards.yml`:
```
- title: "Award name"
  organization: "Awarding body"
  year: 2026
  description: "One line"
```

## Add a position / service role

Add one entry to `_data/positions.yml`:
```
- title: "Role title"
  organization: "Institution"
  start: 2026
  end: "present"
  description: "One line"
```

## Change the top navigation menu

Edit `_data/navigation.yml`. Reorder, add, or remove entries under `main:`. Removing an entry hides that section from the menu but doesn't delete the content or its page.

## Change your bio / homepage text

Edit `_pages/about.md`.

## Change sidebar info (email, ORCID, Scholar, GitHub, etc.)

Edit the `author:` block near the top of `_config.yml`.

## Change/add a banner or header image on any page

1. Put the image file in `images/`.
2. In that page's front matter, add:
```
header:
  image: /images/your-file.jpg
```

## Push changes live

From the project folder, using a terminal (RStudio's Terminal tab works fine, this is not an R step):
```
git add .
git commit -m "short description of what changed"
git push
```
Check the build succeeded under the repo's **Actions** tab on GitHub, then view the live site at `https://shivakhanal.github.io`.

## Where NOT to make changes

Anything under `_layouts/`, `_includes/`, `_sass/`, or `assets/` is theme/design code, not content. You should never need to touch these for adding or editing content, only if you want to change how the site looks or behaves structurally.
